extraction_quality.review_notes: Chapter 10 is a roadway storm drain design chapter; flood frequencies and Rational/HEC-22 methods are explicit. Water quality BMPs are referenced but not sized in this chapter. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 1 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: Chapter 10 covers storm drain hydrology (Rational Method, max 640 acres), inlet spacing, pipe sizing, and HGL per HEC-22; peak-flow detention may use basins, pipe storage, swales, and channels (Section 10.4.9) with detail in Chapter 12. Water-quality BMP types are referenced via FHWA HEC-22 Chapter 10 only; no WQV depth or SCM sizing parameters appear in the provided excerpts.
